page_title: OSA 2-0 RAY | Osasuna v Rayo Vallecano 14/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+3' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Sergio Herrera has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
90+2' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90+1' Samuel Becerra (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The attendance is 20511.
89' The ratio of the ball possession is 37:63.
84' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
82' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
81' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Pedro Diaz is replaced by Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano).
81' Substitution. Samuel Becerra (Rayo Vallecano) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Florian Lejeune walks off.

77' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Iker Benito (Osasuna) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Jon Moncayola. The score is now 2:0.
74' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
73' Handball by Ante Budimir (Osasuna).
72' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
71' Alessio Lisci decides to make a substitution. Aimar Oroz will be replaced by Iker Benito (Osasuna).
69' A free kick into the box, taken by Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.
68' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) is penalised for holding. Cesar Soto Grado signals a set piece. A free kick has been awarded to Rayo Vallecano.
66' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar.
65' That's the end of the game for Alvaro Garcia, who is replaced by Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano).
64' Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Unai Lopez.
62' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
60' Alessio Lisci has decided to substitute Victor Munoz and he is replaced by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna).
60' Today's match ends for Raul Garcia who will be replaced by Ante Budimir (Osasuna).
57' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
55' Rayo Vallecano take a short corner kick.
54' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.

52' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Rayo Vallecano are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
51' A brilliant cross into the box finds Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.

48' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Augusto Batalla is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
46' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
43' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) receives a yellow card.
43' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) picks up a yellow card.
41' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.
37' It seemed like Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
36' Cesar Soto Grado has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano).
33' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
29' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
28' Rayo Vallecano have a goal ruled out for offside!
24' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) for his blatant foul.
21' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner but it's cleared.
17' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
15' 1 - 0 Goal! Raul Garcia (Osasuna) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 1:0.
14' Osasuna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
13' Osasuna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
10' Luiz Felipe is substituted due to injury. Inigo Perez gives a chance to Jozhua Vertrouwd (Rayo Vallecano).
9' Luiz Felipe (Rayo Vallecano) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
9' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
5' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
3' Osasuna take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
